name: roslyn-mcp
description: Give Codex, Claude Code, and Cursor the compiler's view of a C# solution through one MCP server, with or without Visual Studio.

interface.shortDescription: Answer C# questions from the compiler's view of the solution
interface.longDescription: Declares one MCP server that forwards to a per-user daemon, which loads each C# solution with MSBuild and keeps it loaded across sessions, and routes C# semantic questions through it in Codex, Claude Code, and Cursor. An optional bundled Visual Studio extension serves a solution Visual Studio has open, unsaved editor buffers included.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $roslyn-setup-repo to migrate this repository from the Roslyn MCP 2.x per-solution ports to the plugin's roslyn-mcp server.
